selected_system.positive_representative_caveat: For strictly positive rates this tree generator is similar to a symmetric matrix. The principal block on I1 and I2 of the negative generator is phi4*I, so eigenvalue interlacing bounds its smallest nonzero decay by phi4. The selected slice fixes phi4=1, while the native generating trajectory has minimal order six and all five nonzero decays greater than one. Thus the fixed raw algebraic slice cannot reproduce that complete trajectory with strictly positive rates. This does not rule out an approximate fit on finite samples or trajectory polish that releases the fixed rates.
